# The Hills

> The Hills is a residential and hospitality cluster in Emirates Living, Dubai, set beside the fairways of Emirates Golf Club. Four buildings hold 426 apartments alongside a Vida-branded hotel and serviced-apartment component, with the tallest rising 15 storeys above a basement. Residents and guests share landscaped podium gardens, pools and golf-course views, a short drive from Dubai Marina and Sheikh Zayed Road.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: The Hills, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2019

## MENASCO Scope

The Hills is an Emaar Properties development in Emirates Living, Dubai, overlooking the Emirates Golf Club. It combines B+G+14 residential buildings with 15-storey hotel and serviced-apartment buildings operated under the Vida brand, including Vida Emirates Hills. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the development.
